rows.text: returns at once when byte `+0x18` of `rcx` is 1 or the top three bits of byte `+3` (mask 0xE0) are not 0x60; otherwise, with qword `+0xC0` non-null, it copies bit `0x1` of `dl` into bit `0x1` of that object's byte `+0x70` and tail-jumps to `002E8FD0` with `rcx` and `edx` (low byte masked to bit `0x1`); with qword `+0xC0` null the same bit update is addressed at byte `+0x10` of the null pointer before the same tail-jump

returns at once when byte `+0x18` of `rcx` is 1 or the top three bits of byte `+3` (mask 0xE0) are not 0x60; otherwise, with qword `+0xC0` non-null, it copies bit `0x1` of `dl` into bit `0x1` of that object's byte `+0x40` and tail-jumps to `002E8FD0` with `rcx` and `edx` (low byte masked to bit `0x1`); with qword `+0xC0` null the same bit update is addressed at byte `+0x10` of the null pointer before the same tail-jump
for indices 0 to 3 calls `00263750(index)` and, for each non-null result, calls `002E8060` and then `002EB430` on what `00263F40(result)` returns (`00263F40` is called afresh before each)

calls `002640C0` with the incoming registers, then four times (slots 3 down to 0) stores `002650B0(that result, rcx, 00267E10(r9))` as a pointer in a local array; calls `0031B510(local dword array, 4)`, fills the dwords from its result index up to 3 with -1, writes dword i to pointer i for all four, and returns what `0026B4E0(rcx, that result)` returns (under the stack-cookie check)

compacts the array of `ecx` qwords at `rdx` in place: keeps, in order, each non-null entry for which `002E9600(entry)` returns non-zero, zeroes the slots after the kept ones and returns the kept count (0 when `ecx` is not positive)
